scientific_integrity: Exact proof from two-state transition matrix, positive-coefficient AM-GM symmetrization, and strictly convex quartic sign analysis; separate exact-rational checker. No empirical validation and no claim for larger visit counts.
scientific_limitations: Stationary two-state availability, known site occupancy, no false positives, identical nonadaptive and conditionally independent instantaneous tests, fixed horizon. At a boundary optimum, simultaneous independent replicates must be permitted. Historical priority not independently certified.
title: A sharp endpoint-doublet transition for four surveys of Markovian ecological availability
